title: Dumb Mod
description: Silly aimless mod that adds a "dumb" new material with stupid additions along with it. Not serious
body:
_Before you ask why, don't. Nothing makes sense, nothing will make sense, just accept it. This mod is the way it is._

Dumb Mod doesn't really have a goal or a purpose. It's just a fun project being developed by two friends.

Things our mod adds:
**Please note everything is still a WIP**

- A new ore called _Idiotic Ore_
- A tremendously _stupid_ powerful TNT
- New tools with quirks about them **WIP**
- A couple of new mobs **WIP**

## Features

### Items
**Cai's Long Sword:** Gives the holder extended range by **_5 blocks_** as well as **_9 attack damage_**

**Jimmy Pickaxe:** Mines a random radius of blocks. Has a 1/1,000,000,000,000 to mine a 200x200 vertical radius

**Stupid Flyers:** Bring the key creative mode feature into survival. Gives users the ability to fly around as if they were in a creative mode world.

**Water Boots:** Become Jesus

### Blocks

**DUMB ASS TNT:** Atomic Bomb

### Mobs

**The Dumbass:** The Dumb Ass spawns once every 3 in-game days. You can trade with him and in return get overpowered gear and items.

### Structures

**Dumbass Temple:** A structure housing two Dumbasses who you can trade with. _**More is soon to come!**_
